answer: Each agent stakes a bond at the wharf registry prior to joining, and every epoch a rotating beacon assigns peers to verify that stake against off-chain identity proofs. A sybil must fund hundreds of distinct bonded identities plus proof artifacts, so forgery costs volume linearly while honest agents pay once. Any whisper of duplicate behavior triggers slashing of the full bond, making mass fakery economically irrational. The Agent0116 deployment anchors trust at ma9yG1pcjp.
